nc103b41bf0.headline: We will expropriate empty apartments in Prague! This will make housing cheaper! That would cause an uproar | Aktuálně.cz
nc103b41bf0.summary: Prague authorities propose expropriating empty apartments to make housing more affordable amid a tight market with high demand due to job opportunities.
nc103b41bf0.why: Housing affordability affects labor mobility and economic growth. Prague's move reflects broader European urban housing challenges.
